source: register_map.json; original release lacks command bitfields
request_semantics: Exactly one strobed bit or zero no-op; mixed/unknown requests SLVERR. STOP always accepted. ARM is measurement-ready only, never TX. Requires no pending commit, acknowledged measure mode, nonzero detector bound, ctrl-domain calibration_valid, and no sticky/current fault. Fault or calibration loss disarms.
commit_semantics: Freeze seven words until destination applies at rf_safe_boundary; busy/armed/unsupported mode/zero maximum/capacity overflow reject with SLVERR. Shadow writes remain allowed while busy. ACTIVE_CONFIG_ID changes only after returning acknowledgement. Modes 0 mute and 1 measure only.

snapshot_status.semantics: Sequence increments modulo 2^30 after coherent snapshot returns. Poll BUSY clear and sequence changed before reading LO/HI. Keep one software owner; another snapshot completion can replace both registers between independent reads.

unsupported_semantics: Every other read/write, WO read, RO write and unaligned address returns SLVERR, including bank/DSP/TX control not explicitly implemented. CAPABILITIES stays zero: no allocated release bit meanings.
time_semantics: Free-running unsigned GSC64 increments contract stride 4 per 125 MHz RF clock. Reset starts new boot-local generation at zero; EPOCH_ID=0 and TIME_QUALITY=0 mean externally unqualified. No PPS or persistent epoch implemented.
cdc_reset_contract: Both domains must observe coordinated reset assertion; integration supplies synchronous deassertion per clock. Independent one-domain reset is unsupported. Payload is stable throughout toggle request/ack. ASYNC_REG only marks two-flop control synchronizers; physical bundled-data timing/CDC closure remains required.
limitations: No TX enable: output hard zero
External calibration_valid is integration evidence, not a software bypass; calibration engine absent
Window check only covers pre+post+max<=16384; system detector-history qualification still external
No hardware synthesis timing or board validation claimed
event_semantics: RF-domain512bit attempts pass through CDC mailbox to bounded ctrl queue(default16). EVENT_LATCH action1 snapshots nonempty head; EVENT_WORD0..15 read stable snapshot; EVENT_POP action1 removes only latched head. Invalid commands/empty/unlatched reads SLVERR. RF drop counter requires CDC snapshot before software exposure; not read asynchronously as DROP_EVENT.
